ABOUT US

Our Story

Natures Mustard Oil & Co. is built around a simple belief: when a product becomes part of a family’s everyday kitchen, quality should never be treated as a compromise. Mustard oil has a long and respected place in Indian kitchens, and our purpose is to present that familiar ingredient with care, consistency and a strong sense of responsibility. Our firm name is Natures Mustard Oil & Co., while our mustard oil products are offered under the brand names सरसों सुगंध and सरसों कलश. Mustard Cake is also part of our product range.

Our story is not only about a bottle of oil. It is about the journey from mustard seed to a product that is handled, processed, filtered, stored and presented with attention at every stage. We believe that the trust of a customer is earned through everyday discipline: selecting suitable raw material, maintaining a clean processing environment, paying attention to machinery, keeping the process organized, and communicating honestly about what we offer. This approach guides the way we think about our products and the way we want our business to grow.

Mustard is a crop closely connected with the Indian landscape. Its seeds, flowers and distinctive aroma are familiar across many regions. For us, that connection creates a responsibility to respect the character of mustard while processing it into oil. The objective is not to make unnecessary promises; it is to focus on the fundamentals that customers can understand and appreciate—careful processing, good handling, proper filtration, suitable storage and consistent service. We want the experience of our products to be straightforward: a recognizable mustard oil identity, dependable quality and a brand that customers can remember.

The name सरसों सुगंध represents the aroma and traditional identity associated with mustard oil. The word सुगंध expresses fragrance, character and the sensory experience that people associate with good mustard oil. The name सरसों कलश carries a different visual and cultural feeling: कलश is a familiar Indian symbol of abundance, care and auspiciousness. Both names belong to Natures Mustard Oil & Co., and both are intended to give customers a clear and memorable product identity while keeping the connection with mustard at the center.

Behind every product is a physical process, and we take that process seriously. Our setup includes mustard oil expeller machinery, feeding and conveyor equipment, filtration equipment and supporting systems. Machinery is not simply a display item for us; it is part of the discipline required to process a natural agricultural product. The condition of equipment, the way material moves through the system, the cleanliness of working areas and the handling of oil after extraction all influence the consistency of the operation. That is why we want our customers and business partners to see the real machinery and understand that the product has a real processing journey behind it.

The expeller stage is central to the oil-making process. Mustard seeds are prepared and fed into the processing system, where mechanical extraction produces oil along with mustard cake. The extracted oil then moves through the filtration stage so that unwanted solid particles can be separated before storage. The remaining mustard cake is not simply treated as waste. It is a useful natural by-product with its own commercial applications, and we therefore present Mustard Cake as a product category in its own right.

Filtration and storage are important parts of responsible oil handling. After extraction, oil needs appropriate filtration and clean storage so that the finished product can be handled in an organized manner. Our focus is to maintain a process that is practical, orderly and suitable for a growing business. We also understand that customers and trade partners value consistency. A business cannot depend only on a good first impression; it must develop systems that support the same care from one batch and one order to the next.

Quality, in our view, is more than a word printed on a label. Quality is a combination of raw material, process discipline, cleanliness, filtration, storage, packaging, communication and service. We aim to build our reputation through these fundamentals rather than through exaggerated claims. We want customers to know what the firm stands for and what products we offer. We want retailers and distributors to have a dependable point of contact. We want every enquiry to be treated respectfully, whether it is for a single retail requirement or a larger wholesale opportunity.

Our business is also designed to serve different kinds of customers. Retail customers may be looking for mustard oil for everyday household use. Retailers may be looking for products that are easy to explain and remember. Distributors and wholesale buyers may be interested in regular supply, quantities, packaging and commercial discussions. Agricultural or feed-related buyers may be interested in Mustard Cake. Each customer has a different requirement, and our approach is to listen first, understand the requirement and then discuss the appropriate product and quantity.

We believe a modern food business can respect traditional products while using modern organization and presentation. The traditional character of mustard oil is important to us, but so are clean communication, professional product presentation, accessible contact information and a clear digital presence. This website is part of that effort. It brings together our firm information, product brands, machinery, gallery and contact details in one place so that customers can understand Natures Mustard Oil & Co. before they contact us.

Our location in Village Batour, District Panchkula, Haryana is part of our identity as a local business with ambitions to serve customers beyond the immediate area. We want the business to remain connected to real people, real products and real operations. Our address is Plot No. 4, Behind Dhram Complex, Village Batour, District Panchkula, Haryana, India. Customers and business partners can contact us directly by phone or WhatsApp at 9663809879 or by email at tejwantrajput@gmail.com for product and supply enquiries.

Packaging is another important part of the customer experience. A bottle is the first physical introduction many customers have to a product. That is why we want the product name to be easy to recognize and the bottle presentation to be clear. सरसों सुगंध and सरसों कलश are the names we want customers to remember. At the same time, Natures Mustard Oil & Co. remains the firm name behind the products. Keeping the firm name and product brands distinct helps customers understand the relationship between the company and its products.

Mustard Cake completes an important part of the mustard seed story. When oil is extracted, the seed material remaining after pressing can become a useful by-product. We believe that a responsible business should look at the complete value of the raw material rather than focusing on only one output. By presenting Mustard Cake as a product, we create a clearer path for buyers who need it and make better use of the material generated during oil processing. This is part of our broader approach of respecting agricultural inputs and minimizing unnecessary waste.

As we grow, our priorities remain practical. We want to improve process discipline, maintain suitable equipment, strengthen packaging and presentation, build reliable supply relationships and listen carefully to customer feedback. Growth is meaningful only when it is supported by quality and service. We would rather build a reputation steadily through repeat customers and dependable business relationships than rely only on short-term promotion. Every enquiry, every order and every conversation is an opportunity to improve.

Trust is especially important in food products because the customer takes the product into the home and makes it part of daily life. We understand that responsibility. Our commitment is to be clear about our firm, clear about our brands and focused on careful processing and service. We encourage customers to contact us with questions about products, availability, packaging and wholesale or retail requirements. Good communication helps us understand the market and helps customers make informed choices.

The future of Natures Mustard Oil & Co. is connected to continuous improvement. We want to strengthen our product range without losing the identity that makes mustard oil special. We want to use our machinery and working systems more effectively. We want to develop stronger relationships with retailers, distributors and direct customers. We want our website, packaging and business communication to reflect the same care that we aim to bring to the processing operation. Most importantly, we want the name Natures Mustard Oil & Co. to be associated with sincerity, product care and dependable service.

Our story is therefore a story of an agricultural product, a processing setup, a local business and a long-term intention to earn trust. It begins with mustard seed and continues through extraction, filtration, storage, packaging and customer service. It includes our brands सरसों सुगंध and सरसों कलश, our Mustard Cake product, our machinery and our relationships with customers. We are proud of the work behind the product, and we want to keep learning, improving and serving better.

Thank you for taking the time to know Natures Mustard Oil & Co. We invite you to explore our products, see our machinery and contact us for your requirements. Whether you are a household customer, retailer, distributor or business buyer, we are happy to discuss your needs. Our aim is simple: to offer mustard oil products with a clear identity, careful processing and a service experience built on respect. From Village Batour, District Panchkula, Haryana, we look forward to building lasting relationships with customers who value quality and trust.
